name: What are the biggest mistakes in townhome construction planning?

mainEntity.name: What are the most common mistakes people make when planning a townhome development in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What are the most common mistakes people make when planning a townhome development in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most expensive townhome mistakes usually happen before construction starts. Buyers often assume the lot can support the desired unit count without confirming zoning, setbacks, parking, or fire access. Others underestimate grading, retaining walls, utility upgrades, and soft costs like design and permit fees. Another common issue is over-designing the project before verifying what the site can actually support, which leads to costly revisions during review. A strong planning process starts with feasibility, then moves into schematic design, budgeting, and only then into detailed permit drawings. The goal is to confirm that the project works on paper, in code, and in the ground before committing major capital. Avoiding those early mistakes is often the difference between a smooth project and one that stalls halfway through approvals.
acceptedAnswer.description: The biggest mistakes are buying land before confirming feasibility, underestimating sitework and permit costs, designing too many units for the lot, and ignoring parking, fire access, or utility constraints. These errors often show up as delays, redesigns, and budget overruns.
